source.note: Type names below are exact CSR table entries. Slash-separated labels such as Pleural remotor/abductor MN are one exact neuron type.

rate_anchor.description: No per-muscle rate calibration is available. Mean population rate divided by 30 Hz is clipped to [0, 1]; the 30 Hz anchor is an explicit engineering assumption.

mapping_policy.aggregation: Each exact neuron type and leg is decoded independently using its population mean rate.
mapping_policy.unmapped: Leg motor neurons without one of the exact mapped type names remain in provenance.unmapped_mn; no target is inferred for blank types or MNml*/MNhl* identifier types.
mapping_policy.anatomical_caution: Groups are functional decoder labels. A label-to-joint assignment is a mapping hypothesis, not a measured muscle insertion or validated mechanical action.
